landing.legendTitle: Unknown means nobody has confirmed it yet.
landing.legendBody: Every fuel status uses one of 5 labels: an icon, a word and the report time. Colour is never the only clue.

legend.available: A recent report says this fuel is in stock.
legend.queue: Fuel is there, but a driver reported a line.
legend.stale: The last report has expired. Check before you drive over.
legend.unavailable: A recent report says this fuel has run out.
legend.unknown: No one has reported this fuel yet. We show Unknown instead of guessing, and we never treat missing data as empty.

landing.actionsTitle: 4 buttons on the home screen. That is the whole app.
landing.actionsBody: Big targets, plain words and a speaker on every screen, built for a phone in one hand.

actions.fuel: Nearby stations for petrol, diesel or CNG, with status, distance and directions.

actions.car: Log each refuel to track mileage and monthly fuel spend.

landing.voiceTitle: Every screen can be read aloud, in 4 languages.
